answer: Deposits are visible in lagoon, and relic reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, an attacker cannot recycle one pool of capital across 96 aliases, and each one needs its own funded echo account. A bond of 50% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 5 times over for the same share of the pool. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
